comparison.objective: Buckle a doll into an infant car seat; candidate depins an electrical terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests routing flexible restraint material, inserting buckle tongues, closing a clip, and avoiding the head. Candidate tests precise rigid-tool insertion and controlled tang release with coordinated wire withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both tongues latched, clip positioned/closed, valid strap routing/tension, and safety constraints. Candidate requires one terminal extracted without disturbing adjacent contacts or damaging connector parts.
comparison.reason: The objectives, mechanisms, and tested manipulation abilities are unrelated beyond generic alignment and insertion.
